title: Cecilia Garden
description: The Cecilia flowers that only grow on high cliffs once bloomed in the greenhouses here. The ancient civilization that once enjoyed the scent of the Cecilia was lost, and so too was the sea of white flowers.

targets: Defeat 20 enemies. Time between kills cannot exceed 20 seconds.
Defeat 23 enemies. Time between kills cannot exceed 25 seconds.
Defeat 22 enemies. Time between kills cannot exceed 50 seconds.
Defeat 8 enemies. Time between kills cannot exceed 40 seconds.
Defeat 2 enemies. Time between kills cannot exceed 80 seconds.

title: Clear Pool and Mountain Cavern
description: Mt. Aocang is a place of secret wonders. What at first merely seems like beautiful scenery in fact conceals a stone cave that connects to the heavens and breathes out clouds. Nonetheless, this is not how the saying "where the clouds emerge" was derived.

title: Cloud Retainer's Abode
description: Herein lies the abode of Cloud Retainer. The adeptus desires not to see guests, and the way is shut. A lack of care for where one lays their head is common among all who live. Do you truly wish to enter?

title: Ascend: Clear the Ruins
description:
A huge number of monsters established their camp in the ruins, threatening the safety of the area.
Defeat them all to prove your courage to the Adventurers' Guild.

title: Abyssal Traces
description: The abyssal traces have led you back here. Will the Abyss Herald rear its head and let you witness its transformation brought upon by the Abyssal Gospel?

title: Deserted Ruins of Thermadon
description: Recently discovered underground ruins. Even though the Guild keeps warning of the dangers hidden inside, nothing can go wrong with Bennett by your side, right?

title: Deserted Ruins of Eya
description: Recently discovered underground ruins. Even though the Guild keeps warning of the dangers hidden inside, nothing can go wrong with Bennett by your side, right?

title: Call of the Abyss
description:
The ominous temptations of the Abyss lure the brave and the foolish alike.
No matter the fate that has brought you hither, know that a new thread of fate is already being woven.

pageTitle: Deep Within the Temple of the Falcon
title: Deep Within the Temple of the Falcon
description: The Knights of Favonius have been mobilized to contain Stormterror's destructive rampage. Venture forth with Amber the Outrider to the Temple of the Falcon and stop Stormterror from gaining the power within.

pageTitle: Deep Within the Temple of the Wolf
title: Deep Within the Temple of the Wolf
description: The Knights of Favonius have been mobilized to contain Stormterror's destructive rampage. Venture forth with Cavalry Captain Kaeya to the Temple of the Wolf and stop Stormterror from gaining the power within.

pageTitle: Deep Within the Temple of the Lion
title: Deep Within the Temple of the Lion
description: The Knights of Favonius have been mobilized to contain Stormterror's destructive rampage. Venture forth with Lisa the Librarian to the Temple of the Lion and stop Stormterror from gaining the power within.

title: Beneath the Ancient Tree
description: Underneath the ancient tree of Nantianmen is a mysterious path that none know of. The mysteries of yore lie buried at the end of that road...

title: Behind Enemy Lines
description:
After winning Schubert's trust, he has decided to take you to see his "friends from a distant land."
The Fatui may be skulking within, so make sure to be fully prepared before stepping forward to investigate.

title: Cipher for the Ciphertext
description:
A ciphertext written by an Abyss Mage for an Abyss Mage.
The simplest way to read it is to find an Abyss Mage, of course...

title: Court of Flowing Sand
description: They say that in antediluvian times now lost to history, there was once a foolish ruler who dreamed of building a high garden in honor of the white sacred tree over the primordial sands. Now, dead silence fills the kingdom built on sand, but the obsessions of the past remain.

materialsByQuality.4: Jade Branch of a Distant Sea
materialsByQuality.5: Golden Branch of a Distant Sea

Defeat 10 enemies in less than 6:00 minutes

Defeat 12 enemies in less than 6:00 minutes

title: Delusion Factory
description:
Delusions cannot be allowed to spread throughout Inazuma.
You will not stand by idly and watch as they cause ever more suffering.

title: Crumbling Guilt
description:
After a round of pursuit, you and Itto have reached the ronin hideout.
Only by breaking through the obstacles that lie ahead can you resolve the misunderstanding between the Crimson Oni and the Blue Oni.

title: Beneath the Abandoned House
description: The trail of the elemental powder leads here, to a lone abandoned building that stands atop a cliff in Araumi. Through the crack in the door, you can vaguely see a trap door lying along the floorboards that leads underground. Perhaps this is a secret Fatui base.

title: Chamber of Twisted Cranes
description: A Domain you discovered for the first time while trapped within The Chasm. It seems to have been sealed for a very long time indeed.

title: City of Hidden Runes
description: A Domain you found by accident while searching for the way out. Many mystical mechanisms lie within.

title: Blazin' Trails (Domain)
description: This domain looms large as you visit another island shrouded in illusion. The strange plants around this domain resemble instruments. Perhaps this might prove the ideal stage for a certain resident rocker to show her stuff?

pageTitle: As the Courtyard in Spring Once Appeared: Part I
title: As the Courtyard in Spring Once Appeared: Part I
description: You discover a mysterious space while exploring the now-slightly-different Golden Apple Archipelago. This place seems intimately related to the quaint old bonsai that the Kaedehara Clan kept...

pageTitle: As the Courtyard in Spring Once Appeared: Part II
title: As the Courtyard in Spring Once Appeared: Part II
description: You discover a mysterious space while exploring the now-slightly-different Golden Apple Archipelago. This place seems intimately related to the quaint old bonsai that the Kaedehara Clan kept...

pageTitle: As the Courtyard in Spring Once Appeared: Part III
title: As the Courtyard in Spring Once Appeared: Part III
description: You discover a mysterious space while exploring the now-slightly-different Golden Apple Archipelago. This place seems intimately related to the quaint old bonsai that the Kaedehara Clan kept...

title: Altar of Mirages
description:
The Jinn once used this place as a free theater and a paradise without sorrow or care. The people of the desert wastes also once used this place as a ritual site to remember the ages long past...
But all these joys and sorrows, like a false mirage, would disappear amidst the flow of the Ley Lines.

title: Court of Desolation
description: Some strange association built this secret base at some point during the time of King Deshret. It is said that the secret to reviving the deceased is hidden here. Standing at the gate, you can hear heart-pounding drumming noises ringing in the depths.

title: City of Gold
description: This stronghold, once protected by seven mighty battlements, crumbled overnight when King Deshret fell and an age of chaos ensued. Where gold-eyed warriors once stood guard over watchtowers of gilded luster, now, only a desiccated temple built upon sundered rocks remains, more akin to a tomb for an age of radiance long lost.

title: Akitsu Kimodameshi/Shatterdark
description:
The Akitsu Yuugei grounds located next to the "Test of Courage."
Players can access a special Akitsu Yuugei game via a mystical doorway leading to a Domain.
Stages in this Domain require you to overcome Boss Bricks. Behold as you encounter satirically designed version of opponents rare and familiar on the board, adding a new flavor to your matches...

title: City of the Deceased
description: The then-lords of Gurabad regarded death as the only path to the desert's sacred destination. In order to prevent the wretched from defiling this pilgrimage, they buried the unnamed tomb deep underground... But now, this place has become nothing but a paradise for Wenut and Fungi.

title: Bygone Glories Passed
description: Led by Kusayla's old comrades, you arrive at the final hideout of Deshret's Relics. Fierce resistance is to be expected within, but it is time to call it curtains for vengeance, whether old or new.

title: Brewing Developments
description: While conducting her research, Hajanad has discovered a new Domain with all sorts of opponents wandering within. This Domain provides all the research material she needs to test her Shock-Boiled Brews...

title: A Parade of Providence/Concocted Reaction
description: The bizarre domain Bahador mentioned. Be extra careful while exploring it...

title: Denouement of Sin
description: Legends say that the first Lochknight concealed themselves in the remote wilderness with the Lochfolk, intending to use self-exile and rigorous training in an attempt to repay a sin fated to be beyond redemption. Now, the land has long returned to deathly silence, with the long chill winds still blowing through the deserted valley.

title: Aquanigma
description:
According to the intelligence you have uncovered, this is where the culprit produces the Sinthe. There might be clues to the serial disappearances case inside.
Quickly and carefully explore the place and look for conclusive evidence.

title: Confront Stormterror
description: The towering but broken spire tells of its tragic story silently. Its chambers and halls are filled with memories and longing, as well as howling winds.

title: Beneath the Dragon-Queller
description: Across the long years, this bed of rock, carved into the very heart of the world, has imprisoned Azhdaha like a coffin.

title: Assaulting the Water Imp Kingdom
description: The beautiful Kingdom of Water Imps is at hand. Warriors, together with Prince Thelxie, reclaim it from the monsters occupying it!

pageTitle: Assaulting the Water Imp Kingdom Once More
title: Assaulting the Water Imp Kingdom Once More
description: Evil never sleeps, and has secretly smuggled away the crown that rightfully belongs to Prince Thelxie. Warriors, defeat the abominable thieves, and take back Thelxie's crown!

title: Dance of Resolute Will
description: Costentin has discovered a unique Domain, within which is hidden the stage constructed by the legendary "Blade Dancer" so many years ago. According to Costentin, when fighting on this stage, one can "set free a passionate hymn, praising the art that are the instincts of life."

title: Chiwang Terrace (Quest Domain)
description: In days now long forgotten, the ancestors of Chenyu Vale's people called this place the Hanging Gardens, with only their chosen shamans having the right to ascend to this place to listen to the teachings of the heavens and bring a blessing like that of the moon to the bountiful mountain plains. These ancient rituals have long since ceased, but the spirit veins of Chenyu Vale still gather in this place. Whosoever controls Chiwang Terrace may yet have the power to reshape the water and soil in this land in an instant...

title: Ancient Watchtower
description: Legend has it that in ancient times, the colossal beasts that roamed the land had a civilization of their own. After exploring the entirety of the land and surrounding sea, they built these structures in an attempt to cast their gaze upon the even wider world beyond. But these wise beasts have long since vanished, and in the present, no one now knows the true purpose of this place.

materialsByQuality.2: Delirious Decadence of the Sacred Lord
materialsByQuality.3: Delirious Desolation of the Sacred Lord
materialsByQuality.4: Delirious Demeanor of the Sacred Lord
materialsByQuality.5: Delirious Divinity of the Sacred Lord

title: Blazing Ruins
description: In that era, when people had yet to attain true mastery of the flames, there were sages in all corners of the world who pondered the fire and sought to fathom its mysteries. It is said that these ruins are all that is left of what was once a ring-shaped ceremonial site. Here, these sages attempted to perfect the rituals required to transform phlogiston. Among the heroes who later followed the mighty one into the belly of the volcano, there were several who once trained in this place.

title: "Realm of the Night Kingdom"
description: This is the realm of the dead, where the "River of Concepts" flows. Kachina, who is trapped here, is putting up a desperate struggle. Rescue her before its too late!

title: Bastion of Nightmares
description: Based on Miko's information, you and Mizuki manage to find Emura Chuuya's hiding place. Alone on a small island, this isolated house seems to harbor some kind of mystery. Even though there is a palpable sense of danger in the air, the two of you decide to venture inside...

title: Derelict Masonry Dock
description: An environment incomprehensible to the inhabitants of today's lands, one where ash-gray mechanisms driven by golden runes replaced the toil of flesh, effortlessly bringing brilliance and imagination to life above pools of flame. After this era was ended by tyrannical outsiders, the once-powerful race stagnated in their submission. Now, the only visitors left to this place are mourners of a bygone era.

title: Binding Field of Universal Nirvana
description: Irminsul, that tree that once sustained memory, is now doomed to be turned by the fires of calamity into nothing but ash and dust. And if the roots of the mortal world are the spared further corruption, then the self-proclaimed "enlightened" heretic must be confronted one last time...

title: Eagle's Gate
description: Both the prideful eagles and noble souls favor transcendent heights apart from the secular world. In days past, those who despised mortal squabbles as the eagles do could find peace of mind in this place.

title: Domain of Forsaken Ruins
description: Many of those who come here now do so solely to search for nearby treasure. Just as crowds naturally leave a theater after the curtain falls, this once thriving colony has now been reduced to all but empty remains.

title: Domain of Guyun
description: Delusions and disappointments of an ancient ambition to lead humanity are gathered here. It refuses to give up on its lofty ambitions, though it is for now consigned to fester in the cavernous depths of Guyun.

Defeat 28 enemies while protecting Domain Monolith

Defeat 20 enemies while protecting Domain Monolith

title: Domain of the Wayward Path
description: Although Treasure Hoarders have long heard of treasures hidden here, they have yet to discover its location. In this world, the more one clings to delusions, the more quickly they slip through one's fingers. Only when the heart's desires are finally cast aside can the narrow path to peace be found.

title: Enter the "border"
description:
After sufficient preparation, you follow Hu Tao into the mysterious "border."
Remember her warning and don't make a fuss about anything that waits ahead.

title: Enter the Golden House (Quest Domain)
description:
Your pursuit of the truth brings you to the very heart of the political storm that has been slowly brewing in Liyue Harbor.
It is time to peer beyond the glittering gold, and see what lurks in the shadows...

title: Energy Amplifier/2021-04-30/Twisted Realm
description: The power of the Irminsul Fruit Fragments have twisted this Domain, creating bizarre traps and constantly attracting powerful enemies to dwell within. If you wish to plumb its depths; you too must possess the power of the Irminsul Fruit...

pageTitle: Empty Boat of a Thousand Gates
title: Empty Boat of a Thousand Gates
description: This tengu annex dwelling that floats upon the sea like a lonesome boat once played host to the somewhat famous "Yougou Three," and this would later become the cage in which they, having despaired, spent the rest of their days.<ref group="Note">The English translation "and this would later become the cage in which they (Yougou Three), having despaired, spent the rest of their days." has somewhat deviated from the original Chinese . The phrase is an archaic expression which is almost always used as a singular. Therefore, a more plausible interpretation would be "Thereafter, [this boat] became the house of seclusion (lit. bird cage) in which this person (Reizenbou), having despaired, spent the rest of of her days in vain and [the boat] finally sunk into the sea."</ref>

title: Dilapidated Old House
description:
Following Kageroumaru, you come across a dwelling.
Unexpectedly, Kageroumaru ran into the house, catching everyone unawares and leaving the trail cold.
You'll have to follow him in if you wish to continue this investigation...

title: Energy Amplifier/2021-12-24/Deceitful Domain
description: The entrance to this strange domain only sometimes appears on land. To brave warriors, this is the best training ground possible. As such, it is also the best place to gather data using the Energy Amplifier.

pageTitle: End of the Oneiric Euthymia (Quest Domain)
title: End of the Oneiric Euthymia (Quest Domain)
description: Countless dreams once blew about here like petals in the wind, never to be fulfilled. This is the origin of Eternity, and it is also "her" end.

title: Deus Foundry
description: "Creating a god... Yes, we are using human wisdom to create a god!" — Azar

title: Fabulous Fungus Frenzy/Special Training
description:
These special training grounds in the mountains west of Port Ormos have been reserved for the Nilotpala Cup Beast Tamers Tournament. You can learn how to conduct Coordinated Assaults and Zone Defense here to strengthen your bonds with your Fungi.
It is said that these training grounds were once a Domain infested by monsters and outlaws that was declared a "suitable venue for special training" by the organizer after many surveys.
"Actual combat can quickly improve your skills," so they say, and not falsely, but there are some foes in here that are still very concerning indeed...

title: Fabulous Fungus Frenzy/Championship Progress
description:
These tournament grounds in Port Ormos have been reserved for the Nilotpala Cup Beast Tamers Tournament. You can view match progress and access the main arena via a secret passage near the match noticeboard to duke it out with your next opponent.
It is said that upon hearing that this location attracts the largest crowds, the organizers of the Nilotpala Cup put much effort into developing an abandoned Domain nearby and renovating it into the main tournament arena...

title: Fane of Panjvahe
description: The significance of oases lies in the embrace of the desert. The oasis dwellers have never been oblivious to this. Thus did the ancestors in Gurabad build the hermitage for the Lord of Desert. Through the sandstorm-shrouded past and present, this hermitage has become an asylum for countless desert dwellers, among whom are some bandits as well...

title: Entanglement of Past Dreams
description: The restless force within Jialiang has beckoned him ceaselessly, drawing everyone to this place. Here, the stench of evil is growing, and the curtains of fate are soon to fall.

title: Fayz Trials/2023-06-21
description: A new research facility built using the Akademiya's funds. Certain nearby monsters can be lured here to be used as involuntary research subjects.

title: Echoes of the Deep Tides
description: Legend speaks of a time in the distant past, when the Sovereign of the Waters had not yet returned from confinement, there was another God King who dreamed of building a prosperous empire out of harmonious music atop the waves. But the great ambition of building a utopia failed to come to fruition, and the arrogance of humanity sunk into their depths along with their pride. The golden melodies long silent, only the cold music of the tides still echoes upon the remains of their grand altars.

materialsByQuality.3: Wine Goblet of the Pristine Sea
materialsByQuality.4: Silver Goblet of the Pristine Sea
materialsByQuality.5: Golden Goblet of the Pristine Sea

title: Enter the Golden House
description: The storm clouds gathering over Liyue have finally parted, and the schemes that once gripped this land have been shattered by the combined efforts of the Qixing, the Adepti, and yourself. Still the memories of your duel with Childe of the Fatui in the depths of the Golden House remain fresh in your mind. Relive this duel and you may yet learn something new...

title: End of the Oneiric Euthymia
description: Countless dreams once blew about here like petals in the wind, never to be fulfilled. This is the origin of Eternity, and it is also "her" end.

title: Dougier's "Kingdom"
description:
Based on the investigation and prelimary conjecture, the goons of the Beret Society and their victims should be gathered deep within this place.
Dougier must have expected trouble, and has prepared a suitable "welcome gift." As such, extensive preparations should be undertaken before entering.

title: Faded Theater
description: Under the direction of an immortal musician, a certain ancient troupe once performed the elegies of an ancient civilization. With the passage of time, the ancient plays became legend. Legend became myth. ...Until one day, by chance, it was deliberately picked up once more, and became the prelude to a new dream.

title: Energy Amplifier/2024-08-12
description: An uninhabited Domain in a remote location with highly active Ley Lines. They say that this is the ideal testing ground for the Hosseini Amplifier technical trials...

title: Exercise Surging Storm
description: Thanks to their previous experience exchanging information with the armed forces of other nations, the Knights of Favonius have also begun to use "wargaming" to conduct tactical analysis and find ways to improve. Assist the Knights in completing their wargames to strengthen the Knights of Favonius, and improve Mondstadt's security situation...

pageTitle: Envisaged Echo/Scarlet Leaves Pursue Wild Waves
title: Envisaged Echo/Scarlet Leaves Pursue Wild Waves

pageTitle: Enter the "border" (The Funeral Parlor Has No Master, Yujing Terrace Calls the Troops)
title: Enter the "border" (The Funeral Parlor Has No Master, Yujing Terrace Calls the Troops)
description: Returning to this once familiar place, you find it afflicted by a calamity of unknown origin, such that even the director of Wangsheng Funeral Parlor herself has been trapped within. If you choose to venture deeper, you must proceed with the utmost caution.

title: False Moon Institute
description:
A Fatui research facility that stands upon the northern reaches of Nod-Krai. It conceals secrets as deep and uncharted as the structures buried far beneath its foundations.
Even now, when dusk descends upon this place, memories linger of the battle that once tore the very sky asunder.
Yet the moon of Nod-Krai has at last returned to its rightful home, and those who dwell in this sublunary sphere have found tranquility again...

pageTitle: Envisaged Echo/Helm of the Radiant Rose
title: Envisaged Echo/Helm of the Radiant Rose
Midsummer Courtyard
description: With the fall of the ancient lost civilization, the once prosperous and magnificent Sommernachtgarten was also buried underground, leaving only its ancient trees and stones to remember its past glory.

title: Hidden Palace of Lianshan Formula
description: The operation of the Lianshan Formula created endless thunderstorms within the bowels of the mountain. It is said that the rumbling sounds of thunder that one hears outside the domain's gates call out to the curious souls.

title: Forsaken Rift
description: It is said in ancient times, people would venture into the valley to seek out the ancient tree on the altar. They would whisper their secrets into the tree hole, relieving themselves of the burden of keeping the secrets to themselves. The Forsaken Rift is filled with long-forgotten secrets.

title: Lost Treasure of Arcadia
description: Lost treasures reveal themselves only to those with true wisdom. Having solved the mystery of Arcadia, you finally arrive at the site of the treasure...

title: Find the Stolen Book
description: The thief seems to be hiding inside the ruin...

title: Hidden Palace of Guizang Formula
description: Though it may seem like a clear pond, the amount of treasures hidden below is enough to drive a person mad. Unfortunately, few who can decipher its secrets remain.

title: Hidden Palace of Zhou Formula
description: There is a secret ritual that can conceal one gate out of eight, cutting off the route for evil to escape. This ritual was performed here long ago, sealing demons within this labyrinth. Rumor has it that the Method to fit Pillars with Zhou Formula presently seals an evil Chi.

title: Hunt Down the Abyss Mage
description:
The Abyss Mage has disappeared somewhere deep inside this underground ruin.
Do not spare this evildoer.

title: Hypostatic Symphony/2021-01-16
description: Storm Butterfly Intermezzo I

pageTitle: Hypostatic Symphony/2021-01-16/Waltz of Earth, Wind, and Thunder
title: Hypostatic Symphony/2021-01-16/Waltz of Earth, Wind, and Thunder
description:
Join in the chorus of the elements of wind, thunder, and earth.
Challenge the three Pure Hypostases — Anemo, Electro, and Geo — each in their turn.

title: Karma-Heavy Cavern
description: This place attracts monsters corrupted by sinister energy. According to Xiao, their mutation might be connected to his karmic debt...

title: Invitation of Windblume/Peculiar Wonderland
description: The entrance to the Peculiar Wonderland only opens at specific times, and they who enter shall face three random challenges in which they will stand the test of powerful opponents.

title: Frost-Worn Space
description: A Frostarm Lawachurl and the creatures under its command dwell within this Domain. These sniveling supplicants, the Attendants, will likely do everything in their power to defend their lord.

pageTitle: Hidden Teardrop in the Heart of the Jungle
title: Hidden Teardrop in the Heart of the Jungle
description: The party has come to a secret ruin hidden deep in a jungle. One of Dvalin's powerful teardrops lies within. Head inside with Jean and Diluc to track it down.

title: Legend of the Vagabond Sword
description:
Showdown: Ancient Rock Drake I
Challenge a Revived Primo Geovishap that constantly changes Elemental Type.
Even in its long dreams, it would constantly draw energy from the ley lines, perhaps waiting for the day to come when it could rise to meet the sun once more and unleash its long-festering fury, shattering rocks and tearing mountains asunder.

pageTitle: Legend of the Vagabond Sword/Showdown: Ancient Rock Drake
title: Legend of the Vagabond Sword/Showdown: Ancient Rock Drake
description:
Showdown: Ancient Rock Drake I
Challenge a Revived Primo Geovishap that constantly changes Elemental Type.
Even in its long dreams, it would constantly draw energy from the ley lines, perhaps waiting for the day to come when it could rise to meet the sun once more and unleash its long-festering fury, shattering rocks and tearing mountains asunder.
Showdown: Ancient Rock Drake II
Challenge a Revived Primo Geovishap that constantly changes Elemental Type.

pageTitle: Legend of the Vagabond Sword/Lament: Bitter Hate
title: Legend of the Vagabond Sword/Lament: Bitter Hate
description:
Lament: Bitter Hate I
Challenge the Hateful Oceanid, which now shows its true face to its foes.
Having lost its territory and with no access to tranquil waters, the Oceanid writhes in endless grief, longing for all living things to hear the song of the waves and to at last taste the bitterness of tears...
Lament: Bitter Hate II
Challenge the Hateful Oceanid, which now shows its true face to its foes.

pageTitle: Legend of the Vagabond Sword/Battlesong: Ingenious Impermanence
title: Legend of the Vagabond Sword/Battlesong: Ingenious Impermanence
description:
Battlesong: Ingenious Impermanence I
Challenge the Dual Maguu Kenki: Lone Gale and Galloping Frost.
A pair of mysterious puppets lost in the endless process of honing their combat skills finally meet a fearless wanderer in the depths of the world.
Their mechanical bodies and hearts may keep them alive for a thousand years or more, but how many worthy foes can they meet in that time, and how many legendary battles will they fight?
Battlesong: Ingenious Impermanence II
Challenge the Dual Maguu Kenki: Lone Gale and Galloping Frost.

pageTitle: Legend of the Vagabond Sword/Wanderer's Threefold Challenge
title: Legend of the Vagabond Sword/Wanderer's Threefold Challenge
description:
Challenge the Hateful Oceanid, the Revived Primo Geovishap, and the Dual Maguu Kenki each in turn!
There is such a thing as "the rule of three": Good omens must appear three times for good fortune to follow, a true victory requires winning three rounds in succession, and of course, it's good manners to bow thrice at curtain call.

title: Momiji-Dyed Court
description: This court is ever a silent scene of falling red leaves. Perhaps lost causes and unforgettable loves may follow the veins of the earth and coalesce into the fruits of the court's white tree.

title: Formation Estate
description: This estate once belonged to a lieutenant of Orobashi no Mikoto, until he, the body of his god, and the sky alike were rent open by a flash of lightning.

title: Hidden Mountain Base
description:
Following the intelligence you got from Ippei, you discover the Takatsukasa Clan's hidden base.
The Tenryou Commission is in a precarious state, and Kujou Kamaji has not returned. You do not yet know what has happened in this place...

title: Moshiri Kara
description: A mansion that was set up somewhere outside the Sea of Fog. No one knows who built this place, but it seems clear that it is now nothing but a den of ravenous wolves.

title: Fleeting Colors in Flight/Oceanic Defender
description: In a place that the opulent festivities do not reach, a strange monster named Beisht is on the move. Lying in wait in the waters under Guyun Stone Forest, Beisht is preparing a massive offensive. Step into her hiding place and defeat her preemptively to eliminate this nascent threat and defend the festive Liyue Harbor.

title: Misty Hills, Foggy Vales
description: You discover a mysterious space while exploring the now-slightly-different Golden Apple Archipelago. This place seems intimately related to the quaint old bonsai that the Kaedehara Clan kept...

title: Immernachtreich Keep
description: A mysterious realm that only Fischl's text, the "Hymn of the Holy Land," is able to unlock the path to. An austere and sacred aura surrounds this place, and the borders of common sense begin to blur here.

title: Immernachtreich Apokalypse: Part I
description: A mysterious realm that only Fischl's text, the "Hymn of the Holy Land," is able to unlock the path to. An austere and sacred aura surrounds this place, and the borders of common sense begin to blur here.

title: Immernachtreich Apokalypse: Part II
description: A mysterious realm that only Fischl's text, the "Hymn of the Holy Land," is able to unlock the path to. An austere and sacred aura surrounds this place, and the borders of common sense begin to blur here.

title: Immernachtreich Apokalypse: Part III
description: A mysterious realm that only Fischl's text, the "Hymn of the Holy Land," is able to unlock the path to. An austere and sacred aura surrounds this place, and the borders of common sense begin to blur here.

title: Fragment of Childhood Dreams
description: This was once a dreamland paradise of a child of the forest, constructed based on how other children would describe the woods. In their memories, the forest was incredibly vast, much like the world itself. The forest was also immensely deep, just like fate itself. Although the dimensions of the world and the true depth of destiny would ultimately disappoint, the fantasy of them endures deep within this nursery.

title: Garden of Endless Pillars
description: This palatial place was once dominated by many thousands of giant pillars, and priests and the powerful alike once walked beneath their bower unrestrained. But all that is left of the mighty and proud city of sapphire now is wrack and ruin.

title: Hypostatic Symphony/2022-11-24
description: The gates to an unknown Domain have once more swung open, and the Hypostases within have called to themselves a great many attendants to make up formidable fighting forces. Use the mysterious power of Dissonances within the Domain to defeat these mighty foes!

title: Molten Iron Fortress
description: Legend has it that the territory of the red desert was marked by an ancient barrier of iron and bronze. The Lord of the Blazing Sun used to set out from here on his chariot to drive away the evil spirits wandering among the grim mountains. However, the gilded nations later sank into the sand and towering parapets of iron and bronze thus faded into oblivion along with their parent nations, leaving only unrecognizable ruins.

title: Magic Workshop
description: The Magic Workshop once used by Cesar. Judging by the pile of boxes at the entrance, nobody has come here in a very long time...

title: Joururi Workshop
description: The secret workshop hidden in the forest cavern revealed its entrance upon being struck with immense force. The seeds of "surpassing" are sprouting within, and are about to burst forth from the earth...

title: Journey Through Hilinigmatic Terrain
description: A Domain entrance that suddenly appeared in Dadaupa Gorge, and which seems to have something to do with the unusual activities of the hilichurl tribes. The Domain's gate is linked to a wondrous space similar to that of Divine Ingenuity, and the foes within have access to all manner of strange, dazzling tricks...

title: Fayz Trials/2024-03-22
description: The various environmental factors in the Domain Jami sought out to validate the effects of the "Long-Lasting Fayz Potion" all benefit the potion's efficacy. You can try luring nearby creatures to it to collect materials for testing...

title: Mutual Security Enhancing Simulation
description: A venue built by the General Staff of the Millelith for holding a joint wargaming exercise. As the wargaming is still in a trial phase, the budget is limited, in turn restricting the scale of the meeting. Not a Mora was wasted during the construction of the venue. The size is just right for this iteration's requirements, offering enough space for the delegations from each of the neighboring nations...

title: Fearsome Ferocious Firepower
description: Monsters have appeared among a long-deserted complex of ruins. In order to avert disaster, a certain "Genius Inventor" from the Gardes is using his new improved cannon to clear them out — and he's currently looking for a professional to operate it...

title: Lightless Capital
description: Hundreds of years ago, Nod-Krai too experienced a golden age, where adventurers and treasure hunters gathered in droves at the prosperous city that bore the weight of humanity's arrogant dreams, its steel sinews and iron bones reflecting industrial and technological glory at the very edge of the world. Then calamity descended, and objects both living and not were dragged equally into the darkness, while past vibrance and opulence were buried by the ruthless march of time.

waves.name: Cutting Edge Fire Support Ground Effect Landcruiser

title: Lost Mooncourt
description: There was a time when the moon did not rise in solitude as it does today. In those days, three moons caressed the earth with their silver light, and the lunar people knew the secrets of the lunar phases, being able to predict the tidal ebb and flow. Whatever they gently touched with their fingers would surge with moonlit might. Yet in the waning days, the moonlight dimmed, and the people, defenseless and leaderless, were scattered. Legend has it that the Frostmoon Scions constructed a lunar court in the border realms, summoning lost moonlight back to them. Today, that reflected light has disappeared from this forsaken altar. Where it once flowed through these stone carvings, there is now only frozen silence. Yet secrets unveiled in that quietude, perhaps the echoes of ancient oaths, still swirl about within the labyrinth of time.

materialsByQuality.2: Sundered Glory of the Far-North Scions
materialsByQuality.3: Unyielding Delusion of the Far-North Scions
materialsByQuality.5: Aureate Radiance of the Far-North Scions

title: Frostladen Machinery
description: Many sacrifices were made, many obstacles overcome, and many such colossal machines were constructed and then abandoned, all for the sake of ever grander visions. Today, now that this greater goal seems so close at hand, this once-rumbling experimental outpost has come to the end of its service. Its colossal devices have fallen into slumber, leaving behind naught but cold silence.

title: Moonchild's Treasures
description: In an age long forgotten by those who now dwell beneath the moon, the descendants of the far north once raised a tower upon this land. To the followers of the morning star, it served as a sign of their resolve to resist the decree of fate and the will of the gods, and it bore witness to a dream that once shone with radiant brilliance before the sky-fire reduced it to ash. Within this place, the priests of the Moonchildren concealed the last sparks of an ancient civilization's splendor and its long-lost miracles. Their hope was that, when the light of the Welkin Moon at last returned to the earth, it would lead the wandering and displaced back to their former paradise. Yet when the tower fell and its sacred Mekhaneikos were carried off by those with ill intent, the last generations of that distant era let even their hope fade from memory, and they drifted into the shadow of ignorance and confusion. Now, only the owls that remain among these ruins give voice to the dream that time has buried, lamenting what once was and what has long since been forgotten.

title: Retrieve the Treasure
description:
The Abyss Mage has fled into the Domain.
Brave the Domain and retrieve Klee's treasure!

title: Of Mysteries and Salt
description:
The seal has been broken, and both the treasures and the tale of the God of Salt await within.
The party pushes on, each armed with disparate aims...

title: Peak of Vindagnyr
description: This city entombed in snow once had a proud, romantic name to call its own, just as the mountain itself was once lush and verdant in the ancient past. But after the nail that froze the skies over descended upon this mountain, the festive site where priests ascended to face the heavens can no longer hear its voice, nor will those priests ever return again.

title: Ridge Watch
description: Standing proudly over the start of the ridge, these ancient city ruins overlook both north and south, both mountain and river, like a boundary marker. Legend has it that its gates and blessings are only open to those whose hearts are lit with an eternal blaze.

title: Secret Ingredient (Domain)
description: Xiangling is sure that the ingredient she's looking for is hidden somewhere in the depths of this domain. So fight your way to the far end and retrieve it — if you've got the guts!

pageTitle: Retrieve the Holy Lyre der Himmel
title: Retrieve the Holy Lyre der Himmel
description: The treasure of Mondstadt and the power of the Anemo Archon will not simply be handed over quietly. Defeat the guards inside and take back the Holy Lyre der Himmel.

title: Shakkei Pavilion
description: This magnificent mansion was built by an ancient ascetic warrior in the depths of the earth using scenery borrowed from the outside world. At some point during the many years that followed, it was sealed for reasons unknown.

title: Police Detention Center
description: A location being used by the Police Station for temporarily detaining criminals. As well as being heavily guarded, there are also all manners of mechanisms to prevent criminals from escaping.

title: Palace in a Pool
description: They say that long ago, seawater had yet to fill this pool. The moonlight was brighter back then, and it filled the pool instead, flowing freely like quicksilver.

title: Narukami Island: Tenshukaku (Quest Domain)
description: This is where the Raiden Shogun dwells. If your guess isn't off, you are about to meet Signora again.

title: Mystic Onmyou Chamber
description: The great gates of the bizarre and unpredictable Mystic Onmyou Chamber have swung open. The monsters imprisoned within are fierce indeed, but for those who seek truth and wish to temper their martial might, this Domain is a valuable place to challenge themselves...

title: Slumbering Court
description: This great hall stood when Seirai Island neither had the name it has now, nor had it yet been stained with the color of thunder. The scenery within will probably never change, either.

targets: Defeat 10 enemies in less than 6:00 minutes
Defeat 13 enemies in less than 6:00 minutes
Defeat 7 enemies in less than 6:00 minutes
Defeat 7 enemies in less than 6:00 minutes
Defeat 9 enemies in less than 6:00 minutes
Defeat 9 enemies in less than 6:00 minutes

title: Sea Gazer's Abode
description: An abode created by Sea Gazer. It has been abandoned for some time, but the adeptal energies within still power many an automatic defense system to deter trespassers

title: Secret Summoning Chamber
description: The summoning site chosen by Yae Miko. Word on the street is that this is the summoning site with the highest rate of success.

title: Realm of Snaring Illusions
description: A wondrous space hidden within The Chasm's depths. It is a key location filled with many mysteries.

title: Qingxu Pool Underground Ruins
description: These ruins have been here for a very long time indeed, and digging here has temporarily ceased due to hard rocks blocking the path. It is said that rare treasures may be found below.

title: Occupied Hold
description:
This was once a secret holding of the Takatsukasa Clan which was taken over by ronin after being abandoned.
If you should meet any resistance on the way in... Well, might as well check how much strength remains in this mystical sword.

title: Spire of Solitary Enlightenment
description: In ancient times, this was a great and beautiful place, seemingly made to bless the children of humanity. But the arrow of heaven would descend, making mountains out of flat land and burying the ancient capitol beneath the hills.

title: Red Desert Threshold
description: Legend has it that were once a prince who was exiled by his father and imprisoned in this jail. The bronze revelation first emerged here in this lonely, forgotten place where there is neither day nor night.

title: Mysterious Ruins
description: Mysterious ruins that have been hidden deep under layers of sand. An incomprehensible power seems to flow within...

title: Reminiscent Drift
description: The memories of a certain puppet. He can be The Balladeer, Harbinger of the Fatui, and he can also be the kabukimono who was once sighted in Tatarasuna.

title: Secret Cavern
description: Ilyas guided you here. It seems to be the place where Siraj does his experiments...

title: Somalata Inland Sea
description: The fragrant sea underneath the desert is still as luxuriant today as it has always been. Nobody knows when the marvelous sentient Fungi moved in and became part of the ecology of the underground ocean.

title: Purification Spring
description: A water body said to be able to wash off all filth and connect to the sea within the earth. Perhaps because of the many similar scents and memories, it is still inhabited by monsters that devoured the remains of greater life forms.

title: Perilous Expedition
description: It is a place beyond ordinary exploration, a valley concealed behind complex terrain, a deserted dead end. No one knows what lies within or what dangers forebode. However, in order to prevent others from accidentally wandering in here, mapping this place out is an act of considerable value.

pageTitle: Secret Summer Paradise/Dance of Flashing Thought
title: Secret Summer Paradise/Dance of Flashing Thought
description: The park's stage and lights are gathered for you. Step up and dance beautifully. Defeat all foes in your path with your excellent skills!

title: Pale Forgotten Glory
description:
In the past, the great white armada that traversed the seas was Fontaine's supreme pride and glory, for the Mistress of Rivers and Oceans blessed her people with the authority and wish to conquer all the waters of the world. However, this lofty ambition was insufficient to overcome the laws of fate.
To this day, on the brass masts are inscribed the words: "I have conquered the waves of the four seas."

title: Narukami Island: Tenshukaku
description: This is the dwelling of the Raiden Shogun, who rules over Inazuma. It is also the perfect place for a "duel before the throne."

title: Shadow of Another World
description: The behemoth that once devoured the birthing waters of the planet has departed without a single trace, but those in the know will forever live, surely, in the terrifying shadow of that omen of the end. A single shard of shattered spacetime remains in this place, and through it, you may perhaps be able to witness that titanic creature once more.

title: Place of Secrets
description: Fatui intelligence indicates that this place may play host to heretofore unknown clues...

pageTitle: Roses and Muskets/Trick Shots, Tricky Lights
title: Roses and Muskets/Trick Shots, Tricky Lights
description: A filming studio set up by Melies specifically for her experimental films. All kinds of sets and props have been prepared within, awaiting only a professional and reliable "stunt double" to take the stage...

title: Roses and Muskets/Xtreme Drive
description: An abandoned Domain that Helene picked out — near the city, flat, and empty. Here, a type of extreme testing will take place using Stabilization Mekaballs based on stabilization platforms...

title: Rolling Crossfire
description: The "Genius Inventor" of the Gardes has created a new kind of remote cannon. In order to test its combat effectiveness, they are looking for professionals to participate in firing experiments...

title: Scattered Ruins
description:
This courtyard was once a wonder to behold, but now lies desolate.
The previous battle has been buried like the dying light, but the next duel shall come, as long as the "Family" endures...

title: Spino Doubleblaster
description: The engineer Brest is testing the Improved Crocomorph Vortex-Based Crocodilian-armored Heavy Naval Battleship-style Recreational Water Blasting Cannon on the outskirts of Fontaine. She is all too happy to let others experience the joys the Improved Crococannon can bring...

title: Place of Revelations
description: Dain brings you to where he hid the "eye" before. As you continue onward, the answers will soon be revealed. But when you step within, there seems to be something strange going on with Dain...

title: Rawat's Private Laboratory
description: With the aid of the clues you found in Rawat's residence, you found this hidden underground laboratory. The truth behind Rawat's disappearance and the case may be hidden within...
subLocation: Fontaine Research Institute of Kinetic Energy Engineering Region

title: Of Thorns and Crowns
description: A Domain that is rarely visited, filled with all kinds of tricky imaginary challenges. It is said to be surmountable only by warriors gifted with both intellect and courage...

title: Sanctum of Rainbow Spirits
description: It is said that the first sage to learn how to use phlogiston created a place of great purity, and that within this place, warriors were taught to wield the power of prismatic flames and flowing light. Later, even before they were used to resist common enemies, these powers were employed as weapons in conflicts between the tribes. Disheartened by this state of affairs, the Sage of the Stolen Flame withdrew from the world, vanishing from the pages of many tales. Devoid of their original purpose, these empty trial grounds were left behind, along with all those stories that came to be forgotten…

title: Remnants of the Secret Source
description: The sole path to the Night Kingdom. Once home to ancient dragonkind, now reduced to ruins. Influenced by the Abyss, the site harbors many unforeseen dangers...

pageTitle: Remnants of the Secret Source (Beneath the Secret Source)
title: Remnants of the Secret Source (Beneath the Secret Source)
description: A dragon ruin from antiquity. Within it are hidden large devices that can affect the Ley Lines. You must make every second count if The Captain and Ororon's radical plan is to be stopped.

title: On the Path to War
description:
Now that the Ancient Names have been forged, you are ready to step onto the final battlefield — for friends, for the beings that inhabit this land, for the flames, and for the legacy that shall be left behind...
(This Domain may take some time to complete. For the best experience, it is recommended that you experience the next part of the story when you have ample time to complete it.)

title: Seven-Hued Ruins (Domain)
description: Finally, following Etchemin's directions, Citlali managed to find the entrance to the ruined battlefield. All this time, it turns out that the secrets of the Battle of Seven Colors lay buried deep underground...

title: Realm of Feasts Long Forgotten
description: According to the notes left by Modeste, this was where Remurian foreign legionaries once drank and made merry... But the spirits have vanished into whispers on the wind, and a veil of dust sleeps over every glass.

title: Phantom of the Sanctuary
description: Once a sacred place of the ancient Hyperboreans, its grand architecture stood as proof of their devotion to the moons. Yet now, even these crumbling ruins have turned to ash. The travelers should be well aware of the fate that befell them, and the new beginnings born in its wake.

title: Taishan Mansion
description: Once, people who sought the path of the adepti had to pass the trials of heavens and earth. Taishan Mansion served as the trial of "earth." Now that the adepti have long departed from this realm, Taishan Mansion has also turned into a common treasure trove.

title: Temple of the Lion
description: This used to be a temple devoted to the Lion of the South, but it has long been abandoned. Folklore tells that the dandelions commonly seen riding on the winds across Mondstadt symbolize the blessing of the Lion of the South.

pageTitle: The Reward for Courage is Flight
title: The Reward for Courage is Flight
description: Raptor is lurking somewhere deep inside this temple. You cannot let him escape again. Use what you've learned about gliding to take him down.

title: Temple of the Falcon
description: This ruin used to be a temple devoted to the benevolent Falcon of the West. The Temple of the Falcon has watched over Windrise for thousands of years. Perhaps the winds of the past still linger within its halls.

title: Temple of the Wolf
description: This ruin used to be a temple devoted to the Wolf of the North. Now, the priests are gone, and the temple has been seized by monsters. However, they say that the spirit of the Wolf still watches over the endless fields of Mondstadt from someplace else.

title: Travels of the Moonlit Venturer
description: Beneath the labyrinth lies the unexplored Moonlit Wonderland, a trove of pots and kettles. Search for what hidden treasures await discovery there.

title: The Great Adventurer Stanley
description:
Ellin asked you to search for the greenhorn adventurer Jack within the Temple of the Lion.
It seems he is traveling together with the legendary adventurer, Stanley.

pageTitle: The Wonderful World Of Mr. Cyclops
title: The Wonderful World Of Mr. Cyclops
description:
Though it was agreed to let Teucer visit the "Institute for Toy Research"...
The toughest battles are not fought against a redoubtable foe but in defense of a child's innocence.

title: Storming Terror
description: After a long and daring pursuit of Dvalin, who has been led astray by the Abyss Mages, you are about to finally confront him once and for all.

title: Thunder Sojourn/Automaton Front
description: The traces of the elemental anomalies point to the final Domain! Unprecedentedly powerful Ruin machines linger within... defeat them in one fell swoop.

targets: Defeat the Tenryou Commission Guard reinforcements

title: The Lost Valley
description: The ancient ritual grounds were buried beneath the earth amidst a cataclysm that tore heaven and earth asunder before being uplifted by the descent of an alien object, and finally unveiled by a destructive battle that resulted from a betrayal. Nonetheless, those who once frequented this place are no more.

title: The Islands' Stirring Strings
description: This domain looms large as you visit another island shrouded in illusion. The strange plants around this domain resemble instruments. Perhaps this might prove the ideal stage for a certain resident rocker to show her stuff?

title: The Ancient Azure Stars (Domain)
description: You find this strange realm under Mona's guidance. The way of entering this place is quite unique indeed. You reckon it must have quite the deep association with the genius astrologer...

title: Temple of the Star Latitudes
description: You find this strange realm under Mona's guidance. The way of entering this place is quite unique indeed. You reckon it must have quite the deep association with the genius astrologer...

title: Tower of Abject Pride
description: It is said that the deserts were once home to three sage-kings, one of whom remained lovely and wise till the very end. They parted ways eventually for the sake of the paradise they sought in their hearts. This place is called a "tower," but in truth was the temporary residence of one of these people when they were building that earthly paradise. If one stretches the past back even further, it was once a small shrine built to avoid the wind and the sand.

materialsByQuality.2: Copper Talisman of the Forest Dew
materialsByQuality.3: Iron Talisman of the Forest Dew
materialsByQuality.4: Silver Talisman of the Forest Dew
materialsByQuality.5: Golden Talisman of the Forest Dew

title: Steeple of Ignorance
description: In the ancient past, man-made towers that could touch the skies were built all across the land. Though human hearts flowed downward, their souls aspired toward the high heavens. These towers would always fall, or collapse under their own weight and plummet into the depths. However, if one were to look at things at a grander scale, the heavens and earth are as one — no direction is truly different from another.

title: Under the Umbrella's Shade
description: The poets have it that spores, like trees, are connected to each other, and that all fungal beings in the world share a single dream. At the end of that dream, the spores would take on the forms of all things, and that all things would return to the beginning — return to being one — and that there would never again be boundaries. But the evolution of Fungi into sentient, locomotive beings was not something that happened in such primordial times. Regardless, this place has become fertile soil for Fungi to thrive.

targets: Defeat 18 enemies. Time between kills cannot exceed 20 seconds.
Defeat 3 enemies. Time between kills cannot exceed 40 seconds.

pageTitle: The Coordinates of Sun and Rain
title: The Coordinates of Sun and Rain
description: According to the legends, the goddess who had command over plants would summon forth a spirit of timely rains, whose name was Varuna, or "water and sky." These same legends say that the now-deceased forest king used hedges and streams, and the children of the pomegranate used dreams and illusions to create a labyrinth as deep and intricate as the very roots of trees themselves, to defend the secret of sun and rain.

title: The Dark Valley
description: Legend has it that the moon once had a face. Under the fierce moon's face, like a white bow, the paths through the forest labyrinth would bring lost people to jade and amber dreams. This forest labyrinth has ceased to exist for hundreds of years — and yet even a hundred thousand winters must seem like a day in the garden of dreams.

title: The Contamination's Source
description: The source of contamination that lies deep within the forest. Abnormal Ley Line energy seems to flow out of it

pageTitle: The Shrine of Shouki no Kami
title: The Shrine of Shouki no Kami
description:
Story Review:

You and Nahida rush over to prevent the Akademiya's god-creation plan. After getting through the passageway, you see The Balladeer, who is about to become a god...

title: The Greater Lord's Remaining Consciousness
description:
Story Review:

You and Nahida successfully prevented the Akademiya's god-creation plan. With the Electro Gnosis in hand, you see where your hope of saving Irminsul lies...

title: That Day Under Irminsul
description:
Story Review:

You and Nahida successfully prevented the Akademiya's god-creation plan and uncovered Greater Lord Rukkhadevata's final memory. Now the hope of saving Irminsul lies before your very eyes.

title: Unknown Sanctuary
description: Hilichurls were seen heading towards this place, their steps faithful and unwavering. However, Eide tells you that he's never seen anything like this before...

pageTitle: The Peaks and Troughs of Life
title: The Peaks and Troughs of Life
description: The secret place Macadell found in the wilderness of Fontaine. Various enemies with distinctive features linger inside, covering all Pressurized Impactor test requirements. It makes for an ideal test site...

title: The Realm of Beginnings
description: The Dragon of Verdure once drew up a dreamlike blueprint of life for its people, until the grass turned into sand and the apocalypse came. Then, dreams had to be burned to fuel life. At the end of those "crossroads," their proud forms had been mutilated. In contrast, the new masters of Teyvat who stepped into this land were so beautiful and dazzling...

title: Thelxie's Fantastic Adventures/Purgation Counterstrike
description: In the depths of the Lair of Evil, the scary undersea monsters are invading the home of the Water Imps. Warriors, set up your adventuring team and join forces with Prince Thelxie to expel these dastardly intruders!

pageTitle: The Rhythm that Leads to the Gloomy Path (Domain)
title: The Rhythm that Leads to the Gloomy Path (Domain)

pageTitle: The Rhythm that Nurtures the Sprout (Domain)
title: The Rhythm that Nurtures the Sprout (Domain)

pageTitle: The Rhythm that Reveals the Beastly Trail (Domain)
title: The Rhythm that Reveals the Beastly Trail (Domain)

pageTitle: The Night-Bird Falls at the Curtain's Call (Domain)
title: The Night-Bird Falls at the Curtain's Call (Domain)
Summertide Scales and Tales/Metropole Trials
description: Outside Constellation Metropole, the dutiful guard Alof has created a rhythm-based combat trial based on the tale of the "Owl Musician," and awaits the brave to take the challenge on...

title: The Secret Garden of "Auguste"
description: The ominous scent and the fragrance of "Auguste" have led you here. This journey is at its end, and vengeance is nigh.

title: Tlazolli's Forge
description: A workshop that Tlazolli announced had been abandoned and sealed off. Now, an ominous crackling echoes within...

title: Tepal's "Airborne Workshop"
description: Tepal's "Airborne Workshop," hidden above the clouds. Obsession piled up until it finally reached the vault of heaven.

title: Stone Stele Records
description: A giant stone tablet that has been erected in Natlan, upon which is etched the image of a new hero. Its real foundation was collective will, brought together in the cruicible of brutal battle. The silent carvings that stand here serve as a reminder to all — to forget neither the suffering and resolve of the fallen, nor the sacrifices and contributions of the brave.

title: Unresolved Chess Game
description: If you wish to earn the mages' approval, you must face up to the riddle at hand.

title: Stygian Onslaught
description: A strange Ley Line Disturbance has once again appeared, this time in Liyue's Sal Terrae. You must breach the depths of this unpredictable Domain, for only by defeating powerful foes can the turmoil be quelled... Of course, where danger awaits, so too do extraordinary treasures...

pageTitle: Temple of Cascading Colors: Ch'upikaq Tajin
title: Temple of Cascading Colors: Ch'upikaq Tajin
description: The Source Servants once offered up flowers and candles to The Eighth. But now, all the flowers have withered, and the candlelight has died away. The empty winds still whisper unheard stories of the past.

title: Unknown Ruins
description: Some unknown ruins that Layla once stumbled into by mistake. It seems that many unanswered mysteries remain in the Great Red Sand.

pageTitle: Thorny Crown of the Mountain Wind
title: Thorny Crown of the Mountain Wind
description:
In the ages when the thousand winds could still brush against the Temple of Space, the ancient people of Elysium believed that the city-state, eternally sealed within its coffin, would ultimately overcome the destruction wrought by external corruption, flourishing unceasingly like a sacred forest.
Yet, all things in this world wax and wane. The dream of Elysium shall never return. What remains in the wind is naught but poetry and blooming flowers.

title: Valley of Remembrance
description: After a period of time, the people of the continent lost track of the past. They attempt to explore downwards, searching for the things that they had forgotten. On the other side of the ancient tree's hollow, the secrets of yesterday have become today's treasures.

targets: Defeat 20 opponents within 1 minute (additional time will be gained after each kill).

title: Voyage to the Sanguine Sky
description: This is the Realm of Clouds. Guizhong, its former ruler, acquired several ancient and evil artifacts during her research into mechanics. The adepti created this realm to contain them.

title: Vishap's Rest
description: A group of vishaps that have consumed an Irminsul Fruit Fragment have dominion over this Domain. When defeated, the digested fragments will manifest themselves as volatile High-Energy Crystal Cores...

title: Where Shadows Writhe
description: In this Domain, the agitation of the Irminsul Fruit's energies has resulted in a Plasma Field that constantly encroaches upon the challenge area. Those who walk within the Plasma Field shall be subject to the assault of lightning.

title: Violet Court
description: Sometime in the ancient past, the mountains rose higher than the skies, and the earth was larger than heaven's dome. But one day, the mirror shattered, and the oceans arose. In these legends, this caused the court of the primeval sakura to become sundered from the other islands.

Defeat 10 enemies in less than 6:00 minutes
Defeat 8 enemies in less than 6:00 minutes
Defeat 8 enemies in less than 6:00 minutes
Defeat 10 enemies in less than 6:00 minutes
Defeat 10 enemies in less than 6:00 minutes
Defeat 8 enemies in less than 6:00 minutes

title: Vibro-Crystal/2022-04-21/Harmonics Research Facility
description: A domain that is situated on the outer rim of The Chasm. Vibro-Crystals are positioned on either side of the platform, to be used while testing their harmonics.

title: Warrior's Spirit
description: The capacity to bear the weight of charity and mercy; the capability to wield both blade and might. Such is the first precept of the Warrior's Spirit.

title: Vibro-Crystal/2023-03-14/Harmonics Research Facility
description: A domain that is situated on the outer rim of The Chasm. Vibro-Crystals are positioned on either side of the platform to be used while testing their harmonics.

title: Waterfall Wen
description: An ancient ruined city that was once used by a now-bygone secret order as an ad-hoc site of assembly. Now, all that remains to rule the roost are beasts bereft of language or intellect.

title: Youwang Cauldron
description: This was once a treasure granted to Qiaoying Village by an adeptus from Jueyun. As the tea-making process has changed, the Youwang Cauldron has long ceased to serve the same key function it used to. However, its symbolic role in the hearts of the villagers is likely irreplaceable...

title: Uther's Clothing Factory
description: A suspicious factory located in Fleuve Cendre. It may contain evidence of dishonest business practices on the part of its owner.

pageTitle: What Shape Does the Self Hold (Domain)
title: What Shape Does the Self Hold (Domain)
Vibro-Crystal/2024-04-28/Harmonics Research Facility
description: A domain that is situated on the outer rim of The Chasm. Vibro-Crystals are positioned on either side of the platform to be used while testing their harmonics.

pageTitle: Until the End of the World (Domain)
title: Until the End of the World (Domain)

pageTitle: World Level Ascension: Clear the Monsters in the Ruins
title: World Level Ascension: Clear the Monsters in the Ruins
description: This world is about to become a more dangerous place for adventurers. Unlock new challenges, you who are ready. Ad astra abyssosque!
